_purpose: The STRUCTURAL lock for the mandatory full-corpus audit (memory: full-corpus-audit-before-phase-g). Charter R8 codified as a gate, not a promise: the whole corpus (all claims, every kind) must be audited BEFORE Phase G resumes book mining. The corpus_audit_gate invariant reads this file: while phase_g_unlocked is false, the live claim count may not EXCEED frozen_claim_count, so new claims cannot be mined onto unaudited data (RED the instant they are). This never reds the board during Phase E (count == frozen); it reds only when unaudited mining begins.
frozen_reason: Corpus size at the moment the audit lock was installed (crack #4 fix, 2026-07-06). The 1203 existing claims are the audit's subject; Phase G may add MORE only after the audit signs off.
unlock_protocol: 1. Run `PYTHONUTF8=1 python eden/tools/corpus_audit.py` to regenerate eden/tools/corpus-audit-worklist.md (every claim by kind, machine-flagged suspects).
2. Luneth reviews the worklist per-claim; corrections route through the normal draft->seal pipeline (source rule: heavy interpretation is never automatic).
3. When the review is signed off, set audit_complete=true and phase_g_unlocked=true (and re-anchor frozen_claim_count to the post-audit count).
4. Only then may Phase G mining add new claims.
